visual_identity.core_identity: A stationary cave predator resembling a stalagmite, revealed by one central eye, a toothed mouth, and multiple long adhesive tendrils.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall tapering cone like a stalagmite, broad rooted base, several long rope-like tendrils radiating outward.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; a single eye and horizontal toothed mouth are embedded in the upper body.
visual_identity.body_shape: Conical flexible central trunk with long simple tendrils emerging from its sides.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No walking legs; body remains rooted at a broad base while several long tendrils extend outward.
visual_identity.surface: Rocklike folds and ridges kept sparse enough to preserve camouflage silhouette.

accuracy_checks: could plausibly resemble a stalagmite at rest

known_failure_modes.symptom: roper gains legs or mobile beast body

known_failure_modes.correction: restore tall tapering stalagmite body and rooted base

scene_identity.size_impression: Large tall cave form that can plausibly be mistaken for a stalagmite until tendrils extend.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Rooted firmly to cave floor with tendrils extending while central body remains stationary.
behavior_style: revealing eye and mouth from camouflage
